text:
lina: quick thread about a sidecar-based deeplink pattern for the console nav. idea: open a compact sidecar panel instead of navigating away, update breadcrumbs to include the sidecar item. feedback?
marc: sounds neat. how would the URL look for shareability? full path or shallow?
lina: proposal: keep canonical path for the resource, add a `sidecar` query param and an optional hash for intra-panel anchors. e.g. `/console/models/abc123?sidecar=versions#v3` -> opens versions sidecar and jumps to v3.
olga: accessibility note: when sidecar appears we must announce it (aria-live or role=region) and move focus into the sidecar header with `tabindex=-1` so SR users land in context. also ensure keyboard escape closes sidecar and returns focus to the originating list item.
ben: perf: sidecars should lazy-mount. if `?sidecar=versions` present then hydrate that panel first only. avoid mounting whole page tree to prevent long TTFI. skeleton placeholder + `aria-busy=true` while content loads.
marc: history behaviour? if user opens sidecar and clicks back, should they go back to previous route or just close the sidecar? we should probably not pollute history for toggles.
lina: agree. use replaceState when setting `sidecar` on initial load, but pushState if the user explicitly navigates inside sidecar (e.g., clicking a permalink to a different tab inside it).
ben: sample: ```js
// set sidecar without adding back entry
const url = new URL(location.href);
url.searchParams.set('sidecar','versions');
history.replaceState(null, '', url);
```
olga: also ensure focus ring is visible after programmatic focus; some CSS resets remove outlines. add a utility class for focus-visible after JS focus.
aria-bot: route-scan result: detected similar handlers under `/console/*/items/:id` and `/console/*/resources/:id`. recommendation: extract a shared `openSidecar` client util to centralize param parsing and DRY analytics.
marc: breadcrumbs UX: current crumbs are `Console / Models / Model abc123`. if sidecar opens, append ` / Versions` so users can see state and copy/share that link. clicking that crumb should collapse the sidecar.
olga: skip links: ensure the `#skip-to-content` works even when sidecar is mounted. skip target should prefer the main content, not the sidecar, unless the sidecar is the primary intent of the link.
lina: sharing behaviour: if `?highlight=v3` present we flash a gentle pulse on the anchor for 3s and set `aria-describedby` to explain why it's highlighted. use non-intrusive animation.
ben: edgecases: model not loaded yet -> wait for resource fetch then run anchor scroll and focus. implement a `deferredAction` queue that replays once data is ready.
olga: add tests: keyboard-only flow, SR narration for sidecar opening (expected: "Versions panel opened"), focus return after close, color-contrast check on highlight pulse.
marc: analytics: fire `ui.sidecar_open` with props {resource_id, sidecar, anchor, from_deeplink:true/false}. useful for A/B and retention.
nina: (typo) -> lina: will open a PR with the pattern doc: canonical URL examples, focus management snippets, skeleton / lazy mount guidance, analytics events, and aria test checklist. can folks review later today?
ben: i'll check perf and hydration plan.
olga: will draft the accessibility checklist and a little demo script for QA.
aria-bot: note: scheduled deploy window tomorrow 02:00 UTC may impact sidecar router experiments. recommend toggling behind `console.sidecar_deeplink` feature flag.
lina: perfect. thanks everyone :+1:
